name: groom-card
title: Groom and handover record
for_each: SELECT a.id,p.name FROM appointments a JOIN pets p ON p.id=a.pet_id WHERE a.status NOT IN ('cancelled','no-show')

sections.title: Observed care
sections.sql: SELECT kind,observations,recorded_by,checked_at FROM care_checks WHERE appointment_id=$1 ORDER BY checked_at

sections.title: Grooming charges and recorded receipts
sections.note: Working statement, not a tax invoice. Payments were made elsewhere.
sections.sql: SELECT b.* FROM v_balances b JOIN appointments a ON a.id=b.id JOIN pets p ON p.id=a.pet_id WHERE p.client_id=$1 ORDER BY b.starts_at

sections.title: Recorded incident and response
sections.sql: SELECT p.name AS pet,i.summary,i.urgent,i.action,i.created_at,i.resolved_at FROM incidents i JOIN pets p ON p.id=i.pet_id WHERE i.id=$1
